description: This Python source file defines an integrated Voice Activity Detection (VAD) analyzer class that interfaces with the AIC SDK backend. It manages lazy initialization of the backend VAD, applies optional parameters, and provides methods for setting sample rate and computing voice activity confidence based on the backend's detection state.

classes.name: AICVADAnalyzer
classes.description: A specialized VAD analyzer that integrates with the AIC SDK backend, supporting lazy initialization and configurable parameters for lookback buffer size and sensitivity.

methods.name: bind_vad_factory(self, vad_factory: Callable[[], Any])
methods.description: Attaches or replaces the VAD factory to be used for backend initialization.

methods.name: _apply_backend_params(self)
methods.description: Applies optional lookback buffer size and sensitivity parameters to the backend VAD, if available.

methods.name: _ensure_backend_initialized(self)
methods.description: Ensures that the backend VAD is instantiated; attempts to initialize it if not already done.

methods.name: set_sample_rate(self, sample_rate: int)
methods.description: Sets the sample rate for audio processing and initializes backend VAD accordingly.

methods.name: int num_frames_required(self)
methods.description: Calculates the number of audio frames needed for analysis based on the sample rate (default 10 ms window).

methods.name: float voice_confidence(self, buffer: bytes)
methods.description: Calculates voice activity confidence as 1.0 if speech is detected, otherwise 0.0, by querying the backend VAD.
